sn35.28:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Gayāsīse saddhim bhikkhusahassena || || 2
sn35.28:1.5: Cakkhum bhikkhave ādittam || rūpā ādittā || cakkhuviññāṇam ādittaṃ || cakkhusamphasso āditto || yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi ādittaṃ || ||
sn35.28:1.7: Rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ || jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi || pe || 6-7
sn35.28:1.8: Jivhā ādittā || rasā ādittā || jivhāviññāṇam ādittaṃ || jivhāsamphasso āditto || yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tam pi ādittaṃ || ||
sn35.28:1.10: Rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittam || jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi uyāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi || pe || || 8
sn35.28:1.11: Mano āditto dhammā ādittā manoviññāṇam ādittaṃ manosamphasso āditto || yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tam pi ādittaṃ || ||
sn35.28:1.13: Pāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyasehi ādittanti vadāmi || || 9
sn35.28:1.14: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || rūpesu pi nibbindati || cakkhuviññāne pi nibbindati || cakkhusamphasse pi nibbindati || yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukham vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā tasmim pi nibbindati || la ||
sn35.28:1.15: yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā upajjati vedayitaṃ- -tasmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.28:1.16: nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamhīti ñānaṃ hoti || ||
sn35.28:1.17: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātī ti || || 10
sn35.28:2.2: attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandunti || || 11 Imasmiṃ
sn35.28:2.3: ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhusahassassa anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti || || 1
